item.title: SCMP: China to narrow scope of contentious detention and surveillance measure
item.description: Chinese lawmakers are proposing to restrict a contentious form of detention and police surveillance measure, among other changes to the country’s Criminal Procedure Law. Since RSDL’s introduction in 1996 and expansion in 2012, it has become the harshest form of detention used in state security cases…
